protocol.split_assignment: First24 mirror groups train, last8 development_validation; both members together. Four speed/observation variants cycle within each split. No label-based split selection.
protocol.candidate_generation: Unchanged V18 public geometry pool: stable actual/CV/radial/tangential/stop own probes. Delayed peer plans only, no learned-model/oracle proposals. Original and anchor unchanged.

bootstrap.interpretation: Fresh development descriptive group intervals; no untouched holdout.

protocol.scope: Fresh32-group geometry data for separately pretrained-and-frozen common motion plus response comparison. Original eight Levels, whole-module off/failure, sequential/self-generated candidates, holdout, enhanced closed-loop safety/latency remain required. V16/V15 failures not overridden.
